definitions.explanation: Describes something that is disorderly, illogical, or out of control. As a na-adjective it characterizes a situation, plan, or behavior; as an adverb it intensifies.
Used adverbially in casual speech to mean 'extremely' or 'really.' Functionally equivalent to とても but much more colloquial.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧むちゃくちゃだ。
⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧むちゃくちゃになっている。
examples.english: The room is a complete mess.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧むちゃくちゃで、⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦でき→できる：00557_dekiru⟧そうにない。
examples.english: His plan is so unreasonable that it doesn't seem feasible.

examples.japanese: むちゃくちゃおいしい！
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧むちゃくちゃ⟦{忙|いそが}しかった→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧むちゃくちゃ⟦{面白|おもしろ}くて→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧、⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧しまった。
examples.english: This game is so much fun that I lost track of time.

notes:
A casual variant of ⟦めちゃくちゃ→めちゃくちゃ：05178_mechakucha⟧. Common in spoken Japanese; in writing, ⟦めちゃくちゃ→めちゃくちゃ：05178_mechakucha⟧ is slightly more standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- むちゃくちゃな⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: an absurd story
- むちゃくちゃ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{怒|おこ}る→怒る：00876_okoru⟧: to be furious
- むちゃくちゃ⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧: incredibly fun
- むちゃくちゃ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat a huge amount

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦めちゃくちゃ→めちゃくちゃ：05178_mechakucha⟧: same meaning, slightly more common in writing
- むちゃ: rash; reckless — shorter form, focuses more on unreasonableness
- ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧: very — neutral; not casual

REGISTER:
Casual. Avoid in formal writing or polite speech. Sense 2 (the intensifier) is especially colloquial.
